findings: README accurately describes ZIP matching by paths and uncompressed sizes, but additionally claims a single edited file disqualifies an archive. The independently reproduced equal-size edit contradicts that broader statement.
README promises every organization batch can be undone and every move is recorded; reviewed persistence-after-effects and path-only undo impose material limits not stated in that guarantee.
README distinguishes recoverable Trash from automatic organization and states manual confirmation for cleanup. Caller UI enforcement remains to be reviewed; no production cleanup was executed.
README explicitly says hashes group duplicates, matching source design; it does not provide full byte comparison, physical-identity alias handling or metadata-restored cache protection.
Root license is MIT with 2026 contributor notice. No upstream implementation was copied into production code; isolated verification uses pinned source.
